name: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview
description: Legacy preview model for real-time dialogue and voice-first applications over the Live API. Google recommends migrating to Gemini 3.8 Live, which is the default option for most low-latency voice agent experiences.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview model page
sources.notes: Preview model code, supported data types, and the 131,072 input / 65,536 output token limits. The page states the model is legacy and recommends Gemini 3.8 Live.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Priced together with Gemini 3.8 Live: $0.75 text input, $3.00 or $0.005 per minute audio input, $1.00 or $0.002 per minute image/video input; $4.50 text output, $12.00 or $0.018 per minute audio output. Only the text prices are recorded.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: Recommended replacement is gemini-3.8-live. No shutdown date announced.
